Summary: Quiet week. Scanned HN, GitHub, Lobsters; reviewed 31 candidates and found only three credible names.

## Shortlist

- **Name / handle:** Nadia Haddad (@nhaddad)
- **Project (one line):** A note-taking app that works without internet access, syncing over local wifi only.
- **The hook (why it films):** Two laptops on a table with the router unplugged, still syncing. You can see it work.
- **Why now (with date, or "evergreen"):** Shipped v2.0 on 2026-06-05.
- **Voice (link to their writing/talk):** https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40000301 detailed thread on why she distrusts cloud sync.
- **Arc / stakes:** Built it after losing a year of notes to a shutdown service.
- **Reach (contact path):** GitHub profile links a personal site.
- **Caveat (if any):** none
- **Score:** 4/5 (P4 / Hook4 / Now4 / Voice4 / Arc4 / Reach3). Clear person, demoable offline hook.
- **Source link(s):** https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40000301

- **Arc / stakes:** Ornithologist who taught himself firmware to stop lugging a laptop into the field.
- **Reach (contact path):** GitHub profile https://github.com/opike.

- **Score:** 4/5 (P5 / Hook4 / Now2 / Voice4 / Arc4 / Reach4). Strong protagonist, soft news peg.
